114	/-! ## Cover cocycles -/
115	
116	variable {f S T W}
117	
118	/-- A **Čech 1-cocycle of units** on the finite localization cover `f : ι → A`:
119	a family of units on the double overlaps, equal to `1` on the diagonal, satisfying the
120	cocycle identity on the triple overlaps. -/
121	structure IsCoverCocycle (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) : Prop where
122	  diag_eq_one : ∀ i, diag f S T i (γ i i).val = 1
123	  cocycle : ∀ i j k,
124	    face₂₃ f T W i j k (γ j k).val * face₁₂ f T W i j k (γ i j).val
125	      = face₁₃ f T W i j k (γ i k).val
126	
127	variable (f S T W)
128	
129	/-! ## The identification of tensor powers of the cover algebra -/
130	
131	/-- The `A`-algebra identification of `B ⊗[A] B`, `B := ∀ i, S i`, with the product of
132	the double-overlap localizations. -/
133	noncomputable def piDoubleEquiv :
134	    ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ∀ i, S i) ≃ₐ[A] ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2 :=
135	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.piPiAlgEquiv A S S).trans
136	    (AlgEquiv.piCongrRight fun p =>
137	      IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv' (f p.1) (f p.2) (S p.1) (S p.2) (T p.1 p.2))
138	
139	/-- The `A`-algebra identification of `B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B)` with the product of the
140	triple-overlap localizations. -/
141	noncomputable def piTripleEquiv :
142	    ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ∀ i, S i)) ≃ₐ[A] ∀ t : ι × ι × ι, W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 :=
143	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl (piDoubleEquiv f S T)).trans <|
144	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.piPiAlgEquiv A S fun p : ι × ι => T p.1 p.2).trans <|
145	      AlgEquiv.piCongrRight fun t =>
146	        IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv' (f t.1) (f t.2.1 * f t.2.2) (S t.1)
147	          (T t.2.1 t.2.2) (W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
148	
149	/-- A family of units collected into a unit of the product monoid, with definitionally
150	transparent value and inverse. -/
151	@[simps]
152	def _root_.Pi.unitOf {κ : Type u} (M : κ → Type u) [∀ k, Monoid (M k)]
153	    (β : ∀ k, (M k)ˣ) : (∀ k, M k)ˣ where
154	  val k := (β k).val
155	  inv k := ((β k)⁻¹).val
156	  val_inv := funext fun k => Units.mul_inv _
157	  inv_val := funext fun k => Units.inv_mul _
158	
159	/-- The unit of `∀ p, T p.1 p.2` collecting a family of units on the double overlaps. -/
160	def piUnit (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) : (∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2)ˣ :=
161	  Pi.unitOf _ fun p => γ p.1 p.2
162	
163	@[simp]
164	lemma piUnit_val (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) (p : ι × ι) :
165	    (piUnit T γ).val p = (γ p.1 p.2).val := rfl
166	
167	/-- The descent unit of a family of units on the double overlaps of a finite
168	localization cover: the corresponding unit of `B ⊗[A] B`. -/
169	noncomputable def cocycleUnit (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) : ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ∀ i, S i)ˣ :=
170	  Units.map ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm : (∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) ≃ₐ[A] _).toAlgHom.toRingHom.toMonoidHom
171	    (piUnit T γ)
172	
173	lemma cocycleUnit_val (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) :
174	    (cocycleUnit f S T γ).val = (piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm (piUnit T γ).val := rfl
175	
176	@[simp]
177	lemma piDoubleEquiv_cocycleUnit_val (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) :
178	    piDoubleEquiv f S T (cocycleUnit f S T γ).val = fun p : ι × ι => (γ p.1 p.2).val := by
179	  rw [cocycleUnit_val, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
180	  rfl
181	
182	/-- Multiplicativity of the descent unit in the cocycle. -/
183	lemma cocycleUnit_mul (γ γ' : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) :
184	    cocycleUnit f S T (fun i j => γ i j * γ' i j)
185	      = cocycleUnit f S T γ * cocycleUnit f S T γ' := by
186	  apply Units.ext
187	  simp only [cocycleUnit_val, Units.val_mul, ← map_mul]
188	  rfl

190	/-! ## Transport of the simplicial maps through the identifications
191	
192	Each lemma below is proved by the pi-ext principle `AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi`:
193	both sides, as `A`-algebra maps out of a finite product of localizations of `A`, agree
194	on the coordinate idempotents (a finite computation via
195	`Algebra.TensorProduct.piPiAlgEquiv_tmul` and `Pi.single`-arithmetic, using that all
196	component maps between localizations are canonical), hence are equal.  The forward images
197	of the idempotents are computed from `piDoubleEquiv (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) =
198	Pi.single (i,j) 1` and its triple analogue, plus `1 = ∑ i, Pi.single i 1`. -/
199	
200	lemma piDoubleEquiv_tmul (s t : ∀ i, S i) :
201	    piDoubleEquiv f S T (s ⊗ₜ[A] t)
202	      = fun p : ι × ι =>
203	          IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv' (f p.1) (f p.2) (S p.1) (S p.2) (T p.1 p.2)
204	            (s p.1 ⊗ₜ[A] t p.2) :=
205	  rfl
206	
207	private lemma piTripleEquiv_tmul (s : ∀ i, S i) (v : (∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ∀ i, S i) :
208	    piTripleEquiv f S T W (s ⊗ₜ[A] v)
209	      = fun t : ι × ι × ι =>
210	          IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv' (f t.1) (f t.2.1 * f t.2.2) (S t.1)
211	            (T t.2.1 t.2.2) (W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) (s t.1 ⊗ₜ[A] piDoubleEquiv f S T v t.2) :=
212	  rfl
213	
214	lemma piDoubleEquiv_single_tmul_single (i j : ι) :
215	    piDoubleEquiv f S T ((Pi.single i 1 : ∀ i, S i) ⊗ₜ[A] (Pi.single j 1 : ∀ i, S i))
216	      = Pi.single (i, j) 1 := by
217	  rw [piDoubleEquiv_tmul f S T]
218	  funext p
219	  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
220	  dsimp only
221	  by_cases ha : a = i
222	  · subst ha
223	    by_cases hb : b = j
224	    · subst hb
225	      rw [Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_same, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, map_one,
226	        Pi.single_eq_same]
227	    · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hb, tmul_zero, map_zero,
228	        Pi.single_eq_of_ne (fun hh => hb (congrArg Prod.snd hh))]
229	  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne ha, zero_tmul, map_zero,
230	      Pi.single_eq_of_ne (fun hh => ha (congrArg Prod.fst hh))]
231	
232	lemma piDoubleEquiv_symm_single (i j : ι) :
233	    (piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm (Pi.single (i, j) 1)
234	      = (Pi.single i 1 : ∀ i, S i) ⊗ₜ[A] (Pi.single j 1 : ∀ i, S i) :=
235	  (AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).mpr (piDoubleEquiv_single_tmul_single f S T i j).symm
236	
237	lemma piDoubleEquiv_single_tmul_one (i : ι) :
238	    piDoubleEquiv f S T ((Pi.single i 1 : ∀ i, S i) ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : ∀ i, S i))
239	      = fun p : ι × ι => if p.1 = i then (1 : T p.1 p.2) else 0 := by
240	  rw [piDoubleEquiv_tmul f S T]
241	  funext p
242	  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
243	  dsimp only
244	  by_cases ha : a = i
245	  · subst ha
246	    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.one_apply, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, map_one, if_pos rfl]
247	  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne ha, zero_tmul, map_zero, if_neg ha]
248	
249	lemma piDoubleEquiv_one_tmul_single (j : ι) :
250	    piDoubleEquiv f S T ((1 : ∀ i, S i) ⊗ₜ[A] (Pi.single j 1 : ∀ i, S i))
251	      = fun p : ι × ι => if p.2 = j then (1 : T p.1 p.2) else 0 := by
252	  rw [piDoubleEquiv_tmul f S T]
253	  funext p
254	  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
255	  dsimp only
256	  by_cases hb : b = j
257	  · subst hb
258	    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.one_apply, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, map_one, if_pos rfl]
259	  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hb, tmul_zero, map_zero, if_neg hb]

261	/-- Multiplication `B ⊗[A] B → B` becomes the diagonal restriction. -/
262	lemma lmul'_piDoubleEquiv_symm (w : ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) :
263	    Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' A (S := ∀ i, S i) ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm w)
264	      = fun i => diag f S T i (w (i, i)) := by
265	  have key : (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' A (S := ∀ i, S i)).comp
266	        (piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm.toAlgHom
267	      = Pi.algHom _ _ fun i => (diag f S T i).comp (Pi.evalAlgHom _ _ (i, i)) := by
268	    apply AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi
269	      (fun p : ι × ι => Submonoid.powers (f p.1 * f p.2))
270	    intro q
271	    obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := q
272	    change Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' A (S := ∀ i, S i)
273	        ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm (Pi.single (i, j) 1))
274	      = fun k => diag f S T k ((Pi.single (i, j) 1 : ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) (k, k))
275	    rw [piDoubleEquiv_symm_single f S T i j, Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_apply_tmul]
276	    funext k
277	    rw [Pi.mul_apply]
278	    by_cases hk : k = i
279	    · subst hk
280	      by_cases hj : k = j
281	      · subst hj
282	        rw [Pi.single_eq_same, one_mul, Pi.single_eq_same, map_one]
283	      · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, mul_zero,
284	          Pi.single_eq_of_ne (fun hh => hj (congrArg Prod.snd hh)), map_zero]
285	    · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hk, zero_mul,
286	        Pi.single_eq_of_ne (fun hh => hk (congrArg Prod.fst hh)), map_zero]
287	  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key w

290	lemma piTripleEquiv_descentFace₂₃ (w : ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) :
291	    piTripleEquiv f S T W (Module.descentFace₂₃ A (∀ i, S i) ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm w))
292	      = fun t : ι × ι × ι => face₂₃ f T W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 (w (t.2.1, t.2.2)) := by
293	  have key : (piTripleEquiv f S T W).toAlgHom.comp
294	        ((Module.descentFace₂₃ A (∀ i, S i)).comp (piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm.toAlgHom)
295	      = Pi.algHom _ _ fun t : ι × ι × ι =>
296	          (face₂₃ f T W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).comp (Pi.evalAlgHom _ _ (t.2.1, t.2.2)) := by
297	    apply AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi

312	      by_cases hc : c = j
313	      · subst hc

315	      · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (fun hh => hc (congrArg Prod.snd hh)), tmul_zero,
316	          map_zero, map_zero]
317	    · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (fun hh => hb (congrArg Prod.fst hh)), tmul_zero,
318	        map_zero, map_zero]
319	  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key w

389	    piDoubleEquiv f S T (Module.descentIncl₁ A (∀ i, S i) s)
390	      = fun p : ι × ι => inclLeft f S T p.1 p.2 (s p.1) := by

429	/-! ## The main conversion -/
430	
431	/-- **A Čech 1-cocycle of units on a finite localization cover is a descent
432	1-cocycle.** -/
433	theorem isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit {γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ} (hγ : IsCoverCocycle (f := f) (S := S) (W := W) γ) :
434	    Module.IsDescentCocycle (cocycleUnit f S T γ) where
435	  lmul'_eq_one := by
436	    rw [cocycleUnit_val, lmul'_piDoubleEquiv_symm]
437	    funext i
438	    exact hγ.diag_eq_one i
439	  cocycle := by
440	    apply (piTripleEquiv f S T W).injective
441	    have hu : (cocycleUnit f S T γ).val = (piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm (piUnit T γ).val := rfl
442	    rw [map_mul, hu, piTripleEquiv_descentFace₂₃, piTripleEquiv_descentFace₁₂,
443	      piTripleEquiv_descentFace₁₃]
444	    funext t
445	    exact hγ.cocycle t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2

9	/-!
10	# Faithfully flat descent of modules
11	
12	Let `A → B` be a map of commutative rings and let `M` be a `B`-module.  This file defines
13	descent data on `M` relative to `A → B`, constructs the descended `A`-module `M₀` as an
14	equalizer submodule of `M`, and proves the two fundamental theorems of flat descent for
15	modules:
16	
17	* **effectivity**: if `B` is flat over `A`, the canonical comparison map
18	  `B ⊗[A] M₀ → M` is an isomorphism;
19	* **uniqueness**: if `B` is faithfully flat over `A`, then any `A`-module `N` equipped with
20	  a `B`-module isomorphism `B ⊗[A] N ≃ M` matching the descent datum is canonically
21	  isomorphic to `M₀`.  The engine is the degree `≤ 1` exactness of the Amitsur complex
22	  `0 → N → B ⊗[A] N ⇉ B ⊗[A] B ⊗[A] N`.
23	
24	## Design notes
25	
26	* **Comodule form of a descent datum.**  Classically a descent datum on `M` is a
27	  `B ⊗[A] B`-module isomorphism `φ : M ⊗[A] B ≃ B ⊗[A] M` satisfying a cocycle condition
28	  over the triple tensor product.  We use the equivalent *comodule* (Sweedler-coring)
29	  presentation: a `B`-linear coaction `δ : M →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A] M` (with `B` acting on the left
30	  tensor factor of the target) such that
31	  - (`counit`) the action map `B ⊗[A] M → M`, `b ⊗ₜ m ↦ b • m`, retracts `δ`, and
32	  - (`coassoc`) the two natural liftings of `δ` to `B ⊗[A] B ⊗[A] M` agree on the image
33	    of `δ`.
34	
35	  The dictionary: given `φ`, set `δ m := φ (m ⊗ₜ 1)`; then `B ⊗ B`-linearity of `φ` makes
36	  `δ` `B`-linear and recovers `φ` via `φ (m ⊗ₜ b) = (1 ⊗ b) • δ m`, the cocycle condition
37	  becomes `coassoc`, and the standard normalization becomes `counit`.  Conversely the `φ`
38	  associated to a coaction is automatically invertible.  This presentation avoids putting
39	  (several!) `B ⊗[A] B`-module structures on `B ⊗[A] M` and `M ⊗[A] B`, which do not exist
40	  as mathlib instances.  For a unit `u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ` whose associated `φ` is
41	  `u • ·` on `M = B`, the coaction is `δ x = u.val * (x ⊗ₜ 1)`.
42	
43	* **The descended module** is the equalizer `M₀ = {m : M | δ m = 1 ⊗ₜ m}`, an `A`-submodule
44	  of `M`, realized as the kernel of the `A`-linear map `δ - (1 ⊗ₜ ·)`.
45	
46	* **Effectivity requires only flatness.**  The comparison `B ⊗[A] M₀ → M` is an isomorphism
47	  whenever `B` is flat over `A`: the counit and coassociativity laws make the augmented
48	  complex `M₀ → M ⇉ B ⊗[A] M` contractible after applying `B ⊗[A] -` (the contraction being
49	  the action maps), and flatness identifies `B ⊗[A] M₀` with the corresponding kernel.
50	  Faithful flatness enters only for uniqueness (the Amitsur exactness `N ≅ (B ⊗[A] N)₀`).
51	
52	* Everything is pinned to a single universe `u`; multi-universe binders interact badly with
53	  the tensor-product instance search in downstream files.
54	
55	## Main declarations
56	
57	* `Module.actionMap A B M : B ⊗[A] M →ₗ[B] M`: the action map `b ⊗ₜ m ↦ b • m`.
58	* `Module.DescentDatum A B M`: descent data on the `B`-module `M` relative to `A → B`,
59	  in comodule form.
60	* `Module.DescentDatum.baseChange A B N`: the canonical descent datum on `B ⊗[A] N`.
61	* `Module.DescentDatum.descended`: the descended `A`-submodule `M₀`.
62	* `Module.DescentDatum.comparison`: the canonical map `B ⊗[A] M₀ →ₗ[B] M`, `b ⊗ₜ m ↦ b • m`.
63	* `Module.DescentDatum.comparison_bijective`: **effectivity** — `comparison` is bijective
64	  when `B` is a flat `A`-module.
65	* `Module.DescentDatum.descentEquiv : B ⊗[A] M₀ ≃ₗ[B] M`: the comparison isomorphism.
66	* `Module.DescentDatum.exact_mk_coactionSub`: degree `≤ 1` **Amitsur exactness** for a
67	  faithfully flat `A → B`.
68	* `Module.DescentDatum.unitEquiv : N ≃ₗ[A] (baseChange A B N).descended`: the unit of
69	  descent is an isomorphism (faithfully flat case).
70	* `Module.DescentDatum.equivDescended`: **uniqueness** — an `A`-module `N` with a
71	  datum-compatible isomorphism `B ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[B] M` is canonically `A`-isomorphic to `M₀`.
72	  Two descents of the same datum are therefore canonically isomorphic.
73	-/
74	
75	universe u
76	
77	open TensorProduct
78	
79	namespace Module
80	
81	variable (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
82	variable (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module B M] [IsScalarTower A B M]
83	
84	/-- The `B`-linear action map `B ⊗[A] M →ₗ[B] M`, `b ⊗ₜ m ↦ b • m`, of a `B`-module `M`. -/
85	noncomputable def actionMap : B ⊗[A] M →ₗ[B] M :=
86	  LinearMap.liftBaseChange B (LinearMap.id (R := A) (M := M))
87	
88	@[simp] theorem actionMap_tmul (b : B) (m : M) : actionMap A B M (b ⊗ₜ m) = b • m := rfl
89	
90	theorem actionMap_one_tmul (m : M) : actionMap A B M (1 ⊗ₜ m) = m := by simp
91	
92	variable {A B M}
93	
94	section actionMap
95	
96	variable {X Y : Type u} [AddCommGroup X] [Module A X]
97	
98	/-- Naturality of the action map in `B`-linear maps. -/
99	theorem actionMap_baseChange [Module B X] [IsScalarTower A B X]
100	    [AddCommGroup Y] [Module A Y] [Module B Y] [IsScalarTower A B Y]
101	    (g : X →ₗ[B] Y) (x : B ⊗[A] X) :
102	    actionMap A B Y ((g.restrictScalars A).baseChange B x) = g (actionMap A B X x) := by
103	  induction x with
104	  | zero => simp
105	  | tmul b m => simp
106	  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
107	
108	/-- The action map of `B ⊗[A] X` retracts the base change of `x ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ x`. -/
109	theorem actionMap_baseChange_mk (x : B ⊗[A] X) :
110	    actionMap A B (B ⊗[A] X) ((TensorProduct.mk A B X 1).baseChange B x) = x := by
111	  induction x with
112	  | zero => simp
113	  | tmul b m => simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
114	  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
115	
116	end actionMap
117	
118	variable (A B M) in
119	/-- A descent datum on a `B`-module `M` relative to `A → B`, in comodule (Sweedler-coring)
120	form: a `B`-linear coaction `δ : M → B ⊗[A] M` (`B` acting through the left tensor factor
121	of the target) that is counital and coassociative.  This is equivalent to the classical
122	formulation via a `B ⊗[A] B`-linear cocycle isomorphism `M ⊗[A] B ≃ B ⊗[A] M`; see the
123	module docstring for the dictionary. -/
124	structure DescentDatum where
125	  /-- The coaction of the descent datum. -/
126	  coaction : M →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A] M
127	  /-- The action map retracts the coaction. -/
128	  counit (m : M) : actionMap A B M (coaction m) = m
129	  /-- Coassociativity: the two liftings of the coaction to `B ⊗[A] B ⊗[A] M` agree on
130	  coaction values.  In the classical dictionary this is the cocycle condition. -/
131	  coassoc (m : M) :
132	    (coaction.restrictScalars A).baseChange B (coaction m) =
133	      (TensorProduct.mk A B M 1).baseChange B (coaction m)
134	
135	namespace DescentDatum
136	
137	variable (A B) in
138	/-- The canonical descent datum on a base change `B ⊗[A] N`, with coaction
139	`b ⊗ₜ n ↦ b ⊗ₜ 1 ⊗ₜ n`. -/
140	@[simps coaction]
141	noncomputable def baseChange (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] :
142	    DescentDatum A B (B ⊗[A] N) where
143	  coaction := (TensorProduct.mk A B N 1).baseChange B
144	  counit x := by
145	    induction x with
146	    | zero => simp
147	    | tmul b n => simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
148	    | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
149	  coassoc x := by
150	    induction x with
151	    | zero => simp
152	    | tmul b n => simp
153	    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
154	
155	variable (D : DescentDatum A B M)
156	
157	/-- The `A`-linear difference between the coaction and the canonical map `m ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ m`;
158	its kernel is the descended module. -/
159	def coactionSub : M →ₗ[A] B ⊗[A] M :=
160	  D.coaction.restrictScalars A - TensorProduct.mk A B M 1
161	
162	@[simp] theorem coactionSub_apply (m : M) : D.coactionSub m = D.coaction m - 1 ⊗ₜ m := rfl
163	
164	/-- The descended `A`-module of a descent datum: the equalizer
165	`M₀ = {m : M | δ m = 1 ⊗ₜ m}`. -/
166	def descended : Submodule A M := LinearMap.ker D.coactionSub
167	
168	theorem mem_descended {m : M} : m ∈ D.descended ↔ D.coaction m = 1 ⊗ₜ m := by
169	  rw [descended, LinearMap.mem_ker, coactionSub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
170	
171	/-- The canonical comparison map `B ⊗[A] M₀ →ₗ[B] M`, `b ⊗ₜ m ↦ b • m`.  Flat descent
172	(`comparison_bijective`) asserts this is an isomorphism when `B` is flat over `A`. -/
173	noncomputable def comparison : B ⊗[A] D.descended →ₗ[B] M :=
174	  LinearMap.liftBaseChange B D.descended.subtype
175	
176	@[simp] theorem comparison_tmul (b : B) (m : D.descended) :
177	    D.comparison (b ⊗ₜ m) = b • (m : M) := rfl
178	
179	theorem comparison_eq_actionMap (x : B ⊗[A] D.descended) :
180	    D.comparison x = actionMap A B M (D.descended.subtype.lTensor B x) := by
181	  induction x with
182	  | zero => simp
183	  | tmul b m => simp
184	  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
185	
186	private theorem coactionSub_lTensor_apply (x : B ⊗[A] M) :
187	    D.coactionSub.lTensor B x =
188	      (D.coaction.restrictScalars A).baseChange B x -
189	        (TensorProduct.mk A B M 1).baseChange B x := by
190	  induction x with
191	  | zero => simp
192	  | tmul b m => simp [TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
193	  | add x y hx hy =>
194	      simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
195	      abel
196	
197	/-- The coaction retracts onto the kernel of `coactionSub ⊗ B`: any `x : B ⊗[A] M` on which
198	the two liftings agree is a coaction value, namely of `actionMap x`.  This is the
199	contracting-homotopy computation at the heart of both effectivity and Amitsur exactness. -/
200	theorem coaction_actionMap {x : B ⊗[A] M}
201	    (hx : (D.coaction.restrictScalars A).baseChange B x =
202	      (TensorProduct.mk A B M 1).baseChange B x) :
203	    D.coaction (actionMap A B M x) = x :=
204	  (actionMap_baseChange D.coaction x).symm.trans <| by rw [hx, actionMap_baseChange_mk]
205	
206	/-- **Effectivity of flat descent for modules**: for `B` flat over `A`, the canonical map
207	`B ⊗[A] M₀ → M` out of the descended module is bijective. -/
208	theorem comparison_bijective [Module.Flat A B] : Function.Bijective D.comparison := by
209	  have hexact : Function.Exact (D.descended.subtype.lTensor B) (D.coactionSub.lTensor B) :=
210	    Module.Flat.lTensor_exact B D.coactionSub.exact_subtype_ker_map
211	  have hinj : Function.Injective (D.descended.subtype.lTensor B) :=
212	    Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ D.descended.injective_subtype
213	  have key : ∀ y : B ⊗[A] D.descended,
214	      D.coaction (D.comparison y) = D.descended.subtype.lTensor B y := by
215	    intro y
216	    rw [comparison_eq_actionMap]
217	    refine D.coaction_actionMap (sub_eq_zero.mp ?_)
218	    rw [← coactionSub_lTensor_apply]
219	    exact hexact.apply_apply_eq_zero y
220	  constructor
221	  · intro y z hyz
222	    exact hinj (by rw [← key, ← key, hyz])
223	  · intro m
224	    have hm : D.coactionSub.lTensor B (D.coaction m) = 0 := by
225	      rw [coactionSub_lTensor_apply, D.coassoc m, sub_self]
226	    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (hexact _).mp hm
227	    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
228	    have hcoact : D.coaction (D.comparison y) = D.coaction m := by rw [key y, hy]
229	    have := congrArg (actionMap A B M) hcoact
230	    rwa [D.counit, D.counit] at this
231	
232	/-- The comparison isomorphism `B ⊗[A] M₀ ≃ₗ[B] M` of flat descent. -/
233	noncomputable def descentEquiv [Module.Flat A B] : B ⊗[A] D.descended ≃ₗ[B] M :=
234	  LinearEquiv.ofBijective D.comparison D.comparison_bijective
235	
236	@[simp] theorem descentEquiv_tmul [Module.Flat A B] (b : B) (m : D.descended) :
237	    D.descentEquiv (b ⊗ₜ m) = b • (m : M) := rfl
238	
239	section Amitsur
240	
241	variable [Module.FaithfullyFlat A B]
242	
243	/-- **Amitsur exactness in degrees `≤ 1`**: for a faithfully flat `A → B` and any
244	`A`-module `N`, the sequence `0 → N → B ⊗[A] N ⇉ B ⊗[A] B ⊗[A] N` is exact; here the pair
245	of arrows is encoded by the single map `coactionSub` of the canonical descent datum, whose
246	kernel is the equalizer. -/
247	theorem exact_mk_coactionSub (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] :
248	    Function.Exact (TensorProduct.mk A B N 1) (baseChange A B N).coactionSub := by
249	  apply (Module.FaithfullyFlat.lTensor_exact_iff_exact A B _ _).mp
250	  intro z
251	  constructor
252	  · intro hz
253	    refine ⟨actionMap A B (B ⊗[A] N) z, ?_⟩
254	    have hx := (baseChange A B N).coaction_actionMap (x := z) (sub_eq_zero.mp (by
255	      rw [← coactionSub_lTensor_apply]; exact hz))
256	    rw [baseChange_coaction] at hx
257	    rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
258	    exact hx
259	  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
260	    rw [coactionSub_lTensor_apply, sub_eq_zero]
261	    induction x with
262	    | zero => simp
263	    | tmul b n => simp
264	    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
265	
266	/-- The unit of descent: for a faithfully flat `A → B`, the canonical map identifies an
267	`A`-module `N` with the descended module of the canonical descent datum on `B ⊗[A] N`.
268	This is the degree `0` consequence of Amitsur exactness. -/
269	noncomputable def unitEquiv (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] :
270	    N ≃ₗ[A] (baseChange A B N).descended := by
271	  refine LinearEquiv.ofBijective
272	    ((TensorProduct.mk A B N 1).codRestrict (baseChange A B N).descended fun n => ?_)
273	    ⟨fun n n' h => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
274	  · rw [mem_descended]
275	    simp
276	  · exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.tensorProduct_mk_injective (A := A) (B := B) N
277	      (congrArg Subtype.val h)
278	  · have h0 : (baseChange A B N).coactionSub (y : B ⊗[A] N) = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp y.2
279	    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (exact_mk_coactionSub N (y : B ⊗[A] N)).mp h0
280	    exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext hn⟩
281	
282	@[simp] theorem unitEquiv_apply_coe (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] (n : N) :
283	    (unitEquiv (A := A) (B := B) N n : B ⊗[A] N) = 1 ⊗ₜ n := rfl
284	
285	variable {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
286	
287	/-- **Uniqueness of descent**: if `N` is an `A`-module and `e : B ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[B] M`
288	intertwines the canonical descent datum on `B ⊗[A] N` with `D`, then `N` is canonically
289	`A`-isomorphic to the descended module of `D`.  In particular two descents of the same
290	datum are canonically isomorphic (compose one such equivalence with the inverse of the
291	other). -/
292	noncomputable def equivDescended (e : (B ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[B] M)
293	    (he : ∀ x : B ⊗[A] N,
294	      D.coaction (e x) = ((e : B ⊗[A] N →ₗ[B] M).restrictScalars A).baseChange B
295	        ((baseChange A B N).coaction x)) :
296	    N ≃ₗ[A] D.descended := by
297	  refine (unitEquiv N).trans <|
298	    ((e.restrictScalars A).submoduleMap (baseChange A B N).descended).trans
299	      (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ ?_)
300	  have hinj : Function.Injective
301	      (((e : B ⊗[A] N →ₗ[B] M).restrictScalars A).baseChange B) := by
302	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
303	    exact Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ e.injective
304	  ext m
305	  simp only [Submodule.mem_map]
306	  constructor
307	  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
308	    rw [mem_descended] at hx ⊢
309	    change D.coaction (e x) = 1 ⊗ₜ (e x)
310	    rw [he x, hx]
311	    simp
312	  · intro hm
313	    refine ⟨e.symm m, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply m⟩
314	    rw [mem_descended] at hm ⊢
315	    apply hinj
316	    have := he (e.symm m)
317	    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
318	    rw [← this, hm]
319	    simp
320	
321	@[simp] theorem equivDescended_apply_coe (e : (B ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[B] M)
322	    (he : ∀ x : B ⊗[A] N,
323	      D.coaction (e x) = ((e : B ⊗[A] N →ₗ[B] M).restrictScalars A).baseChange B
324	        ((baseChange A B N).coaction x)) (n : N) :
325	    (D.equivDescended e he n : M) = e (1 ⊗ₜ n) := rfl
326	
327	end Amitsur
328	
329	end DescentDatum
330	
331	end Module

9	/-!
10	# Sections on basic opens as algebras over global sections
11	
12	Mathlib equips the sections `Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)` on a basic open of a scheme `X` with a
13	canonical `Γ(X, ⊤)`-algebra structure (restriction; the instance
14	`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.algebra_section_section_basicOpen`), which for affine `X` is the
15	`Away g` localization (`AlgebraicGeometry.isLocalization_away_of_isAffine`).  This file
16	provides the interface the Čech–Picard dictionary uses to move between this algebra world
17	and the units-of-sections calculus of `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RefinementInjectivity`:
18	
19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.basicRes`: restriction between sections on nested basic opens
20	  as a `Γ(X, ⊤)`-algebra map — for affine `X` **the** map, since any two `Γ(X, ⊤)`-algebra
21	  maps out of `Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)` agree (`Scheme.basicOpen_algHom_ext`);
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsEvInf_self`: the diagonal values `γ(x,x)` of
23	  a unit Čech cocycle are `1` after any restriction — the normalization feeding the
24	  diagonal condition of the descent cocycle.
25	-/
26	
27	set_option autoImplicit false
28	
29	universe u
30	
31	open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace
32	
33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
34	
35	namespace Scheme
36	
37	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
38	
39	/-! ## Restriction between basic opens as an algebra map -/
40	
41	/-- Restriction of sections between nested basic opens, as a map of algebras over the
42	global sections.  (Both algebra structures are the canonical restriction instances.) -/
43	def basicRes (g h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hle : X.basicOpen h ≤ X.basicOpen g) :
44	    Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) →ₐ[Γ(X, ⊤)] Γ(X, X.basicOpen h) where
45	  toRingHom := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom
46	  commutes' a := by
47	    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom
48	        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom a)
49	      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom a
50	    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
51	
52	@[simp]
53	lemma basicRes_apply (g h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hle : X.basicOpen h ≤ X.basicOpen g)
54	    (s : Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)) :
55	    basicRes g h hle s = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s :=
56	  rfl
57	
58	/-- The unit-level restriction between basic opens is `basicRes` on values. -/
59	lemma coe_unitsRestrict_basicOpen (g h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hle : X.basicOpen h ≤ X.basicOpen g)
60	    (u : Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)ˣ) :
61	    (X.unitsRestrict hle u : Γ(X, X.basicOpen h)) = basicRes g h hle u.val :=
62	  rfl
63	
64	/-- Any two algebra maps over the global sections out of the sections on a basic open of
65	an affine scheme are equal: the source is a localization of `Γ(X, ⊤)`. -/
66	theorem basicOpen_algHom_ext [IsAffine X] (g : Γ(X, ⊤)) {C : Type u} [CommRing C]
67	    [Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) C] (φ ψ : Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) →ₐ[Γ(X, ⊤)] C) : φ = ψ :=
68	  (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers g)).elim φ ψ
69	
70	/-! ## Diagonal normalization of unit cocycles -/
71	
72	/-- The diagonal value `γ(x,x)` of a unit Čech cocycle on a pointed cover is `1` after
73	restriction to any open contained in the member at `x`. -/
74	theorem unitsRestrict_unitsEvInf_self {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (x : X)
75	    {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ 𝒰.opens x) :
76	    X.unitsRestrict (le_inf hV hV) (unitsEvInf γ x x) = 1 := by
77	  have e := congrArg
78	    (X.unitsRestrict (le_inf (le_inf hV hV) hV :
79	      V ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x)) (unitsEvInf_trans γ x x x)
80	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict] at e
81	  exact mul_left_cancel (e.trans (mul_one _).symm)
82	
83	end Scheme

85	end AlgebraicGeometry

9	/-!
10	# Unit-valued Čech cocycles on pointed covers and their pullback
11	
12	This file sets up the cocycle-level substrate of the Čech Picard group
13	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic`):
14	
15	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PointedCover`: one open per point, containing it; a
16	  `SemilatticeInf` with an `OrderTop`, refinement `𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x`,
17	  and pullback along a morphism of schemes.
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsCocycle`, `Scheme.unitsH1`: unit-valued Čech 1-cocycles
19	  and `H¹` on a pointed cover; `Scheme.unitsRes`: restriction along a refinement, a group
20	  homomorphism, strictly functorial (`unitsRes_unitsRes`).
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsEvInf`, `Scheme.unitsRestrict`: the pair values of a
22	  unit cocycle and restriction of unit sections, retyped through `Γ(X, U)ˣ`. Statements
23	  phrased through these are honestly `Γ`-typed, so `rw`/`simp` work on them; goals arising
24	  from the `OneCochain` field types (whose carriers go through `unitsPresheaf.obj`) are
25	  closed against them by `exact` — the two spellings are definitionally equal.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle`, `Hom.pullbackUnitsH1`: pullback of
27	  unit cocycles and their `H¹` classes along a morphism of schemes, compatible with
28	  restriction (`unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1`) — the substrate for `CechPic.map`.
29	
30	The file starts with generic `evInf` algebra for `CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups`
31	(values of cochains/cocycles at binary infima commute with `1`, `*`, `⁻¹`); it lives here
32	only because `CechH1.lean` is at the file-size cap, and should move alongside
33	`OneCochain.evInf` when that file is split for a mathlib PR.
34	-/
35	
36	set_option autoImplicit false
37

88	/-! ## Pointed covers -/
89	
90	/-- A pointed open cover of a scheme: one open per point, containing it. Pointed covers
91	are the index discipline of `Scheme.CechPic`: the index type is the carrier of `X` (so
92	everything stays in `Type u`), refinement is indexwise, and pointwise `⊓` makes the
93	refinement order directed. -/
94	structure PointedCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
95	  /-- The member of the cover attached to a point. -/
96	  opens : X → X.Opens
97	  /-- Each point lies in its member. -/
98	  mem_opens : ∀ x, x ∈ opens x
99	
100	namespace PointedCover
101	
102	@[ext]
103	lemma ext {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : ∀ x, 𝒰.opens x = 𝒱.opens x) : 𝒰 = 𝒱 := by
104	  cases 𝒰; cases 𝒱
105	  simpa using funext h
106	
107	instance : SemilatticeInf X.PointedCover where
108	  le 𝒱 𝒰 := ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x
109	  le_refl 𝒰 x := le_rfl
110	  le_trans 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := (h₁ x).trans (h₂ x)
111	  le_antisymm 𝒰 𝒱 h₁ h₂ := ext fun x ↦ le_antisymm (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
112	  inf 𝒰 𝒱 :=
113	    { opens := fun x ↦ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x
114	      mem_opens := fun x ↦ ⟨𝒰.mem_opens x, 𝒱.mem_opens x⟩ }
115	  inf_le_left 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_left
116	  inf_le_right 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_right
117	  le_inf 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := le_inf (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
118	
119	instance : OrderTop X.PointedCover where
120	  top := { opens := fun _ ↦ ⊤, mem_opens := fun _ ↦ trivial }
121	  le_top _ _ := le_top
122	
123	lemma le_def {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x :=
124	  Iff.rfl
125	
126	@[simp]
127	lemma inf_opens (𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover) (x : X) :
128	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens x = 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x :=
129	  rfl
130	
131	@[simp]
132	lemma top_opens (x : X) : (⊤ : X.PointedCover).opens x = ⊤ :=
133	  rfl
134	
135	/-- The pullback of a pointed cover along a morphism of schemes: the pointed cover by
136	preimages, `x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f x)`. -/
137	def pullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) : X.PointedCover where
138	  opens x := f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x)
139	  mem_opens x := 𝒰.mem_opens (f.base x)
140	
141	@[simp]
142	lemma pullback_opens (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (x : X) :
143	    (𝒰.pullback f).opens x = f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x) :=
144	  rfl
145	
146	lemma pullback_mono (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 𝒱 : Y.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) :
147	    𝒱.pullback f ≤ 𝒰.pullback f :=
148	  fun x ↦ ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE (h (f.base x)))).le
149	
150	end PointedCover
151	
152	/-! ## Unit cocycles on a pointed cover and their restriction -/
153	
154	/-- The unit-valued Čech 1-cocycles of `X` on a pointed cover. -/
155	abbrev unitsCocycle (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=
156	  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens
157	
158	/-- The unit-valued Čech `H¹` of `X` on a pointed cover. -/
159	abbrev unitsH1 (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=
160	  PresheafOfGroups.H1 (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens
161	
162	/-- Restriction of unit Čech classes along a refinement of pointed covers, as a group
163	homomorphism. -/
164	def unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) : X.unitsH1 𝒰 →* X.unitsH1 𝒱 :=
165	  H1.resHom fun x ↦ homOfLE (h x)
166	
167	/-- Restriction along refinements of pointed covers is strictly functorial. -/
168	@[simp]
169	lemma unitsRes_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 : X.PointedCover} (h₁ : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱)
170	    (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : unitsRes h₂ (unitsRes h₁ a) = unitsRes (h₂.trans h₁) a :=
171	  H1.res_res _ _ a
172	
173	@[simp]
174	lemma unitsRes_rfl {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} {h : 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
175	    unitsRes h a = a :=
176	  H1.res_id a
177	/-- If `U` is contained in the preimages of two opens, it is contained in the preimage
178	of their intersection. -/
179	lemma Hom.le_preimage_inf (f : X.Hom Y) {U : X.Opens} {V₁ V₂ : Y.Opens}
180	    (h₁ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₁) (h₂ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₂) : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (V₁ ⊓ V₂) :=
181	  fun _ hx ↦ ⟨h₁ hx, h₂ hx⟩
182	
183	/-- The pair value `γ.evInf i j` of a unit Čech cocycle, retyped as a unit section in
184	`Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ` (definitionally equal). Statements phrased through
185	`unitsEvInf` are honestly `Γ`-typed, so `rw`/`simp` work on them; goals arising from the
186	`OneCochain` field types are closed against them by `exact` (definitional bridging). -/
187	def unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
188	    Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ :=
189	  γ.evInf i j
190	
191	/-- Restriction of a unit section along `W ≤ U`, as a group homomorphism between the
192	honest `Γ`-typed unit groups (definitionally the units-presheaf restriction map). -/
193	abbrev unitsRestrict (X : Scheme.{u}) {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) :
194	    Γ(X, U)ˣ →* Γ(X, W)ˣ :=
195	  Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
196	
197	@[simp]
198	lemma one_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (i j : X) :
199	    unitsEvInf (1 : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) i j = 1 :=
200	  rfl
201	
202	@[simp]
203	lemma mul_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ₁ γ₂ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
204	    unitsEvInf (γ₁ * γ₂) i j = unitsEvInf γ₁ i j * unitsEvInf γ₂ i j :=
205	  rfl
206	
207	/-- The cocycle identity for the pair values, in unit-section language. -/
208	lemma unitsEvInf_trans {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j k : X) :
209	    X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
210	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)
211	        (unitsEvInf γ i j)
212	      * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right :
213	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)
214	          (unitsEvInf γ j k)
215	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left :
216	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)
217	          (unitsEvInf γ i k) :=
218	  γ.evInf_trans i j k
219	
220	/-- Restriction along a refinement, at the level of pair values. -/
221	lemma res_unitsEvInf {𝒲 𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (hle : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰)
222	    (i j : X) :
223	    unitsEvInf (γ.res fun k ↦ homOfLE (hle k)) i j
224	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf (hle i) (hle j)) (unitsEvInf γ i j) :=
225	  γ.res_evInf _ i j
226	namespace Hom
227	
228	variable (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 𝒲 : Y.PointedCover}
229	
230	/-- Pullback of the cocycle identity: the pair values of a unit cocycle on `Y`, pulled
231	back through `f : X ⟶ Y` to a common open `T`, still satisfy the cocycle identity. -/
232	private lemma pullback_pair_trans (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 : Y.PointedCover}
233	    (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j k : Y) {T : X.Opens}
234	    (e₁ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)) (e₂ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k))
235	    (e₃ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)) :
236	    f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j) T e₁ (unitsEvInf γ i j)
237	      * f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T e₂ (unitsEvInf γ j k)
238	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T e₃ (unitsEvInf γ i k) := by
239	  have E : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) :=
240	    fun t ht ↦ ⟨e₁ ht, (e₂ ht).2⟩
241	  have ht := congrArg (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T E)
242	    (unitsEvInf_trans γ i j k)
243	  rw [map_mul, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE,
244	    Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at ht
245	  exact ht
246	
247	/-- The pullback of a unit 1-cocycle along a morphism of schemes, on the pulled-back
248	pointed cover. -/
249	def pullbackUnitsCocycle (f : X ⟶ Y) (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
250	    X.unitsCocycle (𝒰.pullback f) where
251	  ev x y _ a b :=
252	    f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) _
253	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y))
254	  ev_precomp x y _ _ φ a b :=
255	    f.unitsAppLE_map (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) φ.op
256	      (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y))
257	  ev_trans x y z _ a b c :=
258	    pullback_pair_trans f γ (f.base x) (f.base y) (f.base z)
259	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) (f.le_preimage_inf b.le c.le)
260	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le c.le)
261	
262	@[simp]
263	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (x y : X) {T : X.Opens}
264	    (a : T ⟶ (𝒰.pullback f).opens x) (b : T ⟶ (𝒰.pullback f).opens y) :
265	    (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).ev x y a b
266	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
267	          (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y)) :=
268	  rfl
269	
270	@[simp]
271	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (x y : X) :
272	    unitsEvInf (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ) x y
273	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y))
274	          ((𝒰.pullback f).opens x ⊓ (𝒰.pullback f).opens y)
275	          (f.le_preimage_inf inf_le_left inf_le_right)
276	          (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y)) :=
277	  rfl
278	
279	@[simp]
280	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_one :
281	    f.pullbackUnitsCocycle (1 : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) = 1 := by
282	  ext x y T a b
283	  exact map_one (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
284	    (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le))
285	
286	@[simp]
287	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_mul (γ₁ γ₂ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
288	    f.pullbackUnitsCocycle (γ₁ * γ₂)
289	      = f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ₁ * f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ₂ := by
290	  ext x y T a b
291	  exact map_mul (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
292	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le))
293	    (unitsEvInf γ₁ (f.base x) (f.base y)) (unitsEvInf γ₂ (f.base x) (f.base y))
294	
295	/-- Pullback of unit cocycles commutes with restriction along a refinement. -/
296	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_res (h : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
297	    (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res (fun x ↦ homOfLE (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h x))
298	      = f.pullbackUnitsCocycle (γ.res (fun y ↦ homOfLE (h y))) := by
299	  ext x y T a b
300	  have h₁ := congrArg
301	    (f.unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒲.opens (f.base y)) T
302	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le))
303	    (res_unitsEvInf h γ (f.base x) (f.base y))
304	  rw [Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h₁
305	  exact h₁.symm
306	
307	/-- Pullback of a single coboundary comparison along a morphism of schemes: the honest
308	`Γ`-typed computation behind `pullbackUnitsCocycle_isCohomologous`. -/
309	private lemma pullback_coboundary (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 : Y.PointedCover}
310	    (γ₁ γ₂ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (α : ∀ i : Y, Γ(Y, 𝒰.opens i)ˣ)
311	    (hα : ∀ i j, Y.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ≤ 𝒰.opens i) (α i)
312	          * unitsEvInf γ₁ i j
313	        = unitsEvInf γ₂ i j
314	          * Y.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right : 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ≤ 𝒰.opens j) (α j))
315	    (x y : X) {T : X.Opens}
316	    (ha : T ≤ (𝒰.pullback f).opens x) (hb : T ≤ (𝒰.pullback f).opens y) :
317	    X.unitsRestrict ha
318	        (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x)) ((𝒰.pullback f).opens x) le_rfl
319	          (α (f.base x)))
320	      * f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
321	          (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb) (unitsEvInf γ₁ (f.base x) (f.base y))
322	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
323	          (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb) (unitsEvInf γ₂ (f.base x) (f.base y))
324	        * X.unitsRestrict hb
325	            (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base y)) ((𝒰.pullback f).opens y) le_rfl
326	              (α (f.base y))) := by
327	  have h' := congrArg
328	    (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb))
329	    (hα (f.base x) (f.base y))
330	  rw [map_mul, map_mul, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h'
331	  rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map]
332	  exact h'
333	
334	/-- Pullback of a cohomology relation along a morphism of schemes. -/
335	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_isCohomologous {γ₁ γ₂ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰}
336	    (h : γ₁.IsCohomologous γ₂) :
337	    (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ₁).IsCohomologous (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ₂) := by
338	  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := h
339	  exact ⟨fun x ↦ f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x)) ((𝒰.pullback f).opens x) le_rfl
340	      (α (f.base x)),
341	    fun x y T a b ↦ pullback_coboundary f γ₁ γ₂ α
342	      (fun i j ↦ hα i j (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE inf_le_right)) x y a.le b.le⟩

infrastructure needed for a Čech-style Picard group (all stated generically; this file

   functorially (`res_res` holds on the nose at the cochain level).

   its values `evInf i j` at the infima `U i ⊓ U j` (`ev_eq_evInf`), and a 1-cocycle can
   be built from classical pair data satisfying the cocycle condition at triple infima

3. **Commutative group structure.** When the presheaf takes values in `CommGrpCat`,

   is then a group homomorphism (`H1.resHom`).

* `CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCochain.evInf`, `ev_eq_evInf`: over a poset with

private lemma map_map (G : Pᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}) {a b c : P} (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : b ≤ c)
    (x : G.obj (op c)) :
    G.map (homOfLE h₁).op (G.map (homOfLE h₂).op x) = G.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op x := by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

namespace OneCochain

/-- The value of a 1-cochain on the binary infimum `U i ⊓ U j`. Over a poset with binary
infima this determines the whole cochain, see `ev_eq_evInf`. -/
def evInf (γ : OneCochain G U) (i j : I) : G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j)) :=
  γ.ev i j (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE inf_le_right)

/-- Over a poset, a 1-cochain is determined by its values on binary infima. -/
lemma ev_eq_evInf (γ : OneCochain G U) (i j : I) {T : P} (a : T ⟶ U i) (b : T ⟶ U j) :
    γ.ev i j a b = G.map (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le)).op (γ.evInf i j) := by
  have h := γ.ev_precomp i j (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le))
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i)) (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j))
  rw [Subsingleton.elim (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le) ≫ homOfLE inf_le_left) a,
    Subsingleton.elim (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le) ≫ homOfLE inf_le_right) b] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- Restriction commutes with evaluation at binary infima. -/
lemma res_evInf {V : I → P} (γ : OneCochain G U) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U i) (i j : I) :
    (γ.res f).evInf i j
      = G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf (f i).le (f j).le)).op (γ.evInf i j) :=
  γ.ev_eq_evInf i j (homOfLE inf_le_left ≫ f i) (homOfLE inf_le_right ≫ f j)

end OneCochain

namespace OneCocycle

/-- The value of a 1-cocycle on the binary infimum `U i ⊓ U j`. -/
abbrev evInf (γ : OneCocycle G U) (i j : I) : G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j)) :=
  γ.toOneCochain.evInf i j

/-- Restriction commutes with evaluation at binary infima. -/
lemma res_evInf {V : I → P} (γ : OneCocycle G U) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U i) (i j : I) :
    (γ.res f).evInf i j
      = G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf (f i).le (f j).le)).op (γ.evInf i j) :=
  γ.toOneCochain.res_evInf f i j

/-- The classical cocycle condition for the pair values of a 1-cocycle: on the triple
infimum, `g i j * g j k = g i k`. -/
lemma evInf_trans (γ : OneCocycle G U) (i j k : I) :
    G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U i ⊓ U j)).op (γ.evInf i j) *
        G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U j ⊓ U k)).op
          (γ.evInf j k) =
      G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U i ⊓ U k)).op
        (γ.evInf i k) := by
  have h := γ.ev_trans i j k (T := U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k)
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)) (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))
    (homOfLE inf_le_right)
  simp only [γ.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf] at h
  exact h

/-- Build a 1-cocycle over a poset with binary infima from classical pair data: values
`g i j` on the binary infima satisfying the cocycle condition on triple infima. -/
def ofPairs (g : ∀ i j, G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j)))
    (hg : ∀ i j k,
      G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U i ⊓ U j)).op (g i j) *
          G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U j ⊓ U k)).op
            (g j k) =
        G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U i ⊓ U k)).op
          (g i k)) :
    OneCocycle G U where
  ev i j _ a b := G.map (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le)).op (g i j)
  ev_precomp i j T T' φ a b := map_map G φ.le (le_inf a.le b.le) (g i j)
  ev_trans i j k T a b c := by
    rw [← map_map G (le_inf (le_inf a.le b.le) c.le) inf_le_left (g i j),
      ← map_map G (le_inf (le_inf a.le b.le) c.le) (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right) (g j k),
      ← map_map G (le_inf (le_inf a.le b.le) c.le) (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left) (g i k),
      ← map_mul, hg i j k]

@[simp]
lemma ofPairs_ev (g : ∀ i j, G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j))) (hg) (i j : I) {T : P}
    (a : T ⟶ U i) (b : T ⟶ U j) :
    (ofPairs g hg).ev i j a b = G.map (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le)).op (g i j) :=
  rfl

lemma ofPairs_evInf (g : ∀ i j, G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j))) (hg) (i j : I) :
    (ofPairs g hg).evInf i j = g i j := by
  change G.map (homOfLE (le_inf (homOfLE inf_le_left).le (homOfLE inf_le_right).le)).op (g i j)
      = g i j
  have h : homOfLE (le_inf (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i)).le
      (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j)).le) = 𝟙 (U i ⊓ U j) :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [h, op_id, G.map_id]
  rfl

lemma evInf_ofPairs (γ : OneCocycle G U) :
    ofPairs (fun i j ↦ γ.evInf i j) (fun i j k ↦ γ.evInf_trans i j k) = γ := by
  ext1

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Tower
import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Basic

/-!
# Trivializations of base-changed modules and their transition units

Let `A` be a commutative ring and `N` an `A`-module.  A **trivialization** of `N` over an
`A`-algebra `C` is a `C`-linear isomorphism `t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C`.  This file develops
the elementary calculus of such trivializations that drives the surjectivity half of the
Čech–Picard dictionary (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CechPicSurjective`):

* `Module.trivialization_ext`: a trivialization is determined by its values on the
  tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n` (they `C`-span the base change).
* `Module.trivializationPush h t`: the pushforward of a trivialization along an
  `A`-algebra map `h : C →ₐ[A] C'`, with `trivializationPush_one_tmul` computing it on
  `1 ⊗ₜ n` as `h (t (1 ⊗ₜ n))`, and strict compositionality
  (`trivializationPush_trivializationPush`).
* `Module.transitionUnit t₁ t₂ : Cˣ`: the unit comparing two trivializations, uniquely
  characterized by `transitionUnit_mul_apply : transitionUnit t₁ t₂ * t₁ x = t₂ x`
  (uniqueness: `transitionUnit_eq_of`).  The cocycle calculus is immediate from the
  characterization: `transitionUnit_self`, the telescoping identity
  `transitionUnit_mul_transitionUnit`, and compatibility with pushforward
  (`map_transitionUnit`).

On a finite localization cover these transition units become a Čech 1-cocycle presenting
the class of an invertible module; see
`AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.LocalizationTrivialization`.

Everything is pinned to a single universe `u`, matching the descent development in
`AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.ModuleDescent`.
-/

universe u

open TensorProduct

namespace Module

variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
variable {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra A C]
variable {C' : Type u} [CommRing C'] [Algebra A C']
variable {C'' : Type u} [CommRing C''] [Algebra A C'']

/-! ## Extensionality on the tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n` -/

/-- Two `C`-linear maps out of `C ⊗[A] N` valued in `C` that agree on the tensors
`1 ⊗ₜ n` are equal: these tensors `C`-span the base change. -/
theorem trivialization_hom_ext {t₁ t₂ : C ⊗[A] N →ₗ[C] C}
    (h : ∀ n : N, t₁ (1 ⊗ₜ n) = t₂ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) : t₁ = t₂ := by
  apply LinearMap.restrictScalars_injective A
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro c n
  have hc : (c ⊗ₜ[A] n : C ⊗[A] N) = c • (1 ⊗ₜ[A] n : C ⊗[A] N) := by
    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, hc, map_smul, h]

/-- Two trivializations agreeing on the tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n` are equal. -/
theorem trivialization_ext {t₁ t₂ : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C}
    (h : ∀ n : N, t₁ (1 ⊗ₜ n) = t₂ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) : t₁ = t₂ :=
  LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective (trivialization_hom_ext h)

/-! ## Pushforward along an algebra map -/

/-- The pushforward of a trivialization `t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C` along an `A`-algebra map
`h : C →ₐ[A] C'`: the composite
`C' ⊗[A] N ≃ C' ⊗[C] (C ⊗[A] N) ≃ C' ⊗[C] C ≃ C'` (with `C'` a `C`-algebra via `h`),
which on the tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n` is `h (t (1 ⊗ₜ n))` (`trivializationPush_one_tmul`). -/
noncomputable def trivializationPush (h : C →ₐ[A] C') (t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C) :
    C' ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C'] C' :=
  letI : Algebra C C' := h.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower A C C' :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (h.commutes a).symm
  ((AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A C C' C' N).symm.trans
    (LinearEquiv.baseChange C C' _ _ t)).trans (AlgebraTensorModule.rid C C' C')

@[simp]
lemma trivializationPush_one_tmul (h : C →ₐ[A] C') (t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C) (n : N) :
    trivializationPush h t (1 ⊗ₜ n) = h (t (1 ⊗ₜ n)) := by
  letI : Algebra C C' := h.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower A C C' :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (h.commutes a).symm
  show (AlgebraTensorModule.rid C C' C')
      (LinearEquiv.baseChange C C' _ _ t
        ((AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A C C' C' N).symm ((1 : C') ⊗ₜ n))) = _
  rw [AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_symm_tmul, LinearEquiv.baseChange_tmul,
    AlgebraTensorModule.rid_tmul, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
  rfl

/-- Pushforward of trivializations is strictly compositional. -/
lemma trivializationPush_trivializationPush (h' : C' →ₐ[A] C'') (h : C →ₐ[A] C')
    (t : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C) :
    trivializationPush h' (trivializationPush h t) = trivializationPush (h'.comp h) t :=
  trivialization_ext fun n ↦ by
    rw [trivializationPush_one_tmul, trivializationPush_one_tmul,
      trivializationPush_one_tmul, AlgHom.comp_apply]

/-! ## Transition units -/

section transitionUnit

variable (t t₁ t₂ t₃ : C ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[C] C)

/-- The **transition unit** between two trivializations of `N` over `C`: the unit of `C`
by which they differ, `transitionUnit t₁ t₂ * t₁ x = t₂ x`
(`transitionUnit_mul_apply`). -/
noncomputable def transitionUnit : Cˣ where
  val := t₂ (t₁.symm 1)
  inv := t₁ (t₂.symm 1)
  val_inv := by
    calc t₂ (t₁.symm 1) * t₁ (t₂.symm 1)
        = t₁ (t₂ (t₁.symm 1) • t₂.symm 1) := by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      _ = t₁ (t₂.symm (t₂ (t₁.symm 1) • 1)) := by rw [map_smul]
      _ = 1 := by
          rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, t₂.symm_apply_apply, t₁.apply_symm_apply]
  inv_val := by
    calc t₁ (t₂.symm 1) * t₂ (t₁.symm 1)
        = t₂ (t₁ (t₂.symm 1) • t₁.symm 1) := by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      _ = t₂ (t₁.symm (t₁ (t₂.symm 1) • 1)) := by rw [map_smul]
      _ = 1 := by
          rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, t₁.symm_apply_apply, t₂.apply_symm_apply]

lemma transitionUnit_val : (transitionUnit t₁ t₂).val = t₂ (t₁.symm 1) :=
  rfl

/-- The defining property of the transition unit. -/
lemma transitionUnit_mul_apply (x : C ⊗[A] N) :
    (transitionUnit t₁ t₂).val * t₁ x = t₂ x := by
  rw [transitionUnit_val, mul_comm]
  calc t₁ x * t₂ (t₁.symm 1)
      = t₂ (t₁ x • t₁.symm 1) := by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = t₂ (t₁.symm (t₁ x • 1)) := by rw [map_smul]
    _ = t₂ x := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, t₁.symm_apply_apply]

/-- The transition unit is the unique unit conjugating the values of `t₁` on the tensors
`1 ⊗ₜ n` into those of `t₂`. -/
lemma transitionUnit_eq_of {u : Cˣ}
    (h : ∀ n : N, u.val * t₁ (1 ⊗ₜ n) = t₂ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) : transitionUnit t₁ t₂ = u := by
  have key : ∀ x : C ⊗[A] N, u.val * t₁ x = t₂ x := by
    intro x
    induction x with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul c n =>
        have hc : (c ⊗ₜ[A] n : C ⊗[A] N) = c • (1 ⊗ₜ[A] n : C ⊗[A] N) := by
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
        rw [hc, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm, h]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, mul_add, hx, hy]
  have h1 := key (t₁.symm 1)
  rw [t₁.apply_symm_apply, mul_one] at h1
  exact Units.ext ((transitionUnit_val t₁ t₂).trans h1.symm)

@[simp]
lemma transitionUnit_self : transitionUnit t t = 1 :=
  transitionUnit_eq_of t t fun n ↦ by rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]

/-- The telescoping identity for transition units: the Čech 1-cocycle relation. -/
lemma transitionUnit_mul_transitionUnit :
    transitionUnit t₂ t₃ * transitionUnit t₁ t₂ = transitionUnit t₁ t₃ :=
  (transitionUnit_eq_of t₁ t₃ fun n ↦ by
    rw [Units.val_mul, mul_assoc, transitionUnit_mul_apply t₁ t₂,
      transitionUnit_mul_apply t₂ t₃]).symm

/-- Transition units are compatible with pushforward of trivializations along an
`A`-algebra map. -/
lemma map_transitionUnit (h : C →ₐ[A] C') :
    transitionUnit (trivializationPush h t₁) (trivializationPush h t₂)
      = Units.map h.toRingHom.toMonoidHom (transitionUnit t₁ t₂) :=
  transitionUnit_eq_of _ _ fun n ↦ by
    have := congrArg h (transitionUnit_mul_apply t₁ t₂ (1 ⊗ₜ n))
    rw [map_mul] at this
    rw [trivializationPush_one_tmul, trivializationPush_one_tmul]
    exact this

end transitionUnit

end Module

import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.BaseChangeTrivialization
import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.LocalizationCocycle

/-!
# The transition cocycle of a locally trivialized module, and its Picard class

Let `A` be a commutative ring, `N` an `A`-module, and `f : ι → A` a finite family with
localization models `S i`, `T i j`, `W i j k` away from the single, double and triple
products as in `AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.LocalizationCocycle`.  Given trivializations
`e i : S i ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[S i] S i` on the members of the cover, this file:

* forms the **transition cocycle** `trivializationCocycle e i j : (T i j)ˣ` — the
  transition unit between the two pushforwards of `e i` and `e j` to the overlap — and
  shows it is a Čech cover cocycle (`isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle`), the diagonal
  and cocycle conditions being instances of the transition-unit calculus of
  `AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.BaseChangeTrivialization` plus the uniqueness of `A`-algebra
  maps out of localizations;
* assembles the componentwise trivializations into one over the cover algebra
  `B := ∀ i, S i` (`Module.piTrivialization`);
* proves the **descent identification** (`picClass_trivializationCocycle`): the Picard
  class of the descent cocycle associated with the transition cocycle is the class of
  `N` itself.  The compatibility of the assembled trivialization with the twisted
  descent datum reduces, through the identification `B ⊗[A] B ≃ ∀ p, T p.1 p.2`, to the
  defining property of the transition units, and uniqueness of descent
  (`Module.DescentDatum.equivDescended`) identifies the descended module with `N`.

This is the algebraic heart of the surjectivity of the Čech–Picard descent homomorphism
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.toPic_surjective`).
-/

universe u

open TensorProduct

/-! ## Assembling componentwise trivializations over a finite product -/

namespace Module

variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
variable {S : ι → Type u} [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra A (S i)]
variable {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]

/-- The canonical `A`-linear distribution of a base change over a finite product of
`A`-algebras. -/
noncomputable def piBaseChangeDistrib :
    ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[A] ∀ i, S i ⊗[A] N :=
  (TensorProduct.comm A _ _).trans ((TensorProduct.piRight A A N S).trans
    (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun i ↦ TensorProduct.comm A N (S i)))

@[simp]
lemma piBaseChangeDistrib_tmul (b : ∀ i, S i) (n : N) :
    piBaseChangeDistrib (S := S) (b ⊗ₜ n) = fun i ↦ b i ⊗ₜ n := by
  funext i
  simp [piBaseChangeDistrib, TensorProduct.piRight_apply]

variable (e : ∀ i, (S i ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[S i] S i)

/-- The `A`-linear map underlying `piTrivialization`: `n ↦ (i ↦ e i (1 ⊗ₜ n))`. -/
private noncomputable def piTrivializationBase : N →ₗ[A] ∀ i, S i where
  toFun n i := e i (1 ⊗ₜ n)
  map_add' n m := by
    funext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
  map_smul' a n := by
    funext i
    simp only [RingHom.id_apply, Pi.smul_apply, ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
      map_smul_of_tower]

/-- Componentwise trivializations of `N` over a finite family of `A`-algebras assemble
into a trivialization over the product algebra, sending `1 ⊗ₜ n` to
`fun i ↦ e i (1 ⊗ₜ n)` (`piTrivialization_one_tmul`). -/
noncomputable def piTrivialization :
    ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[∀ i, S i] ∀ i, S i := by
  refine LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (LinearMap.liftBaseChange (∀ i, S i) (piTrivializationBase e)) ?_
  have key : ⇑(LinearMap.liftBaseChange (∀ i, S i) (piTrivializationBase e))
      = (fun v i ↦ e i (v i)) ∘ ⇑(piBaseChangeDistrib (S := S)) := by
    funext x
    induction x with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul b n =>
        funext i
        simp only [LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, Function.comp_apply,
          piBaseChangeDistrib_tmul]
        have hb : (b i ⊗ₜ[A] n : S i ⊗[A] N) = b i • ((1 : S i) ⊗ₜ[A] n) := by
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
        rw [hb, map_smul]
        simp [piTrivializationBase, smul_eq_mul]
    | add x y hx hy =>
        rw [map_add, hx, hy]
        funext i
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_add, Pi.add_apply]
  rw [key]
  exact ((Equiv.piCongrRight fun i ↦ (e i).toEquiv).bijective).comp
    (piBaseChangeDistrib (S := S)).bijective

@[simp]
lemma piTrivialization_one_tmul (n : N) :
    piTrivialization e (1 ⊗ₜ n) = fun i ↦ e i (1 ⊗ₜ n) := by
  show LinearMap.liftBaseChange (∀ i, S i) (piTrivializationBase e) (1 ⊗ₜ n) = _
  rw [LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, one_smul]
  rfl

end Module

/-! ## The transition cocycle on a finite localization cover -/

namespace IsLocalization.AwayCover

open Module

variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
variable (f : ι → A)
variable (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra A (S i)]
  [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (f i) (S i)]
variable (T : ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j, CommRing (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra A (T i j)]
  [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (f i * f j) (T i j)]
variable (W : ι → ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j k, CommRing (W i j k)]
  [∀ i j k, Algebra A (W i j k)]
  [∀ i j k, IsLocalization.Away (f i * (f j * f k)) (W i j k)]
variable {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]

variable (e : ∀ i, (S i ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[S i] S i)

/-- The **transition cocycle** of a family of trivializations on a finite localization
cover: on each overlap, the transition unit between the pushforwards of the two
trivializations. -/
noncomputable def trivializationCocycle (i j : ι) : (T i j)ˣ :=
  transitionUnit (trivializationPush (inclLeft f S T i j) (e i))
    (trivializationPush (inclRight f S T i j) (e j))

/-- The defining property of the transition cocycle on the tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n`. -/
lemma trivializationCocycle_mul (i j : ι) (n : N) :
    (trivializationCocycle f S T e i j).val * inclLeft f S T i j (e i (1 ⊗ₜ n))
      = inclRight f S T i j (e j (1 ⊗ₜ n)) := by
  have h := transitionUnit_mul_apply (trivializationPush (inclLeft f S T i j) (e i))
    (trivializationPush (inclRight f S T i j) (e j)) (1 ⊗ₜ n)
  rwa [trivializationPush_one_tmul, trivializationPush_one_tmul] at h

/-- The transition cocycle is a Čech cover cocycle: the diagonal and cocycle conditions
follow from the transition-unit calculus and uniqueness of `A`-algebra maps out of
localizations. -/
theorem isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle :
    IsCoverCocycle (f := f) (S := S) (W := W) (trivializationCocycle f S T e) := by
  constructor
  · -- diagonal: the two pushforwards to `T i i` agree, so the transition unit is `1`
    intro i
    have hlr : inclLeft f S T i i = inclRight f S T i i :=
      (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers (f i))).elim _ _
    have h1 : trivializationCocycle f S T e i i = 1 := by
      rw [trivializationCocycle, hlr, transitionUnit_self]
    rw [h1, Units.val_one, map_one]
  · -- cocycle: push all three transition units to the triple overlap and telescope
    intro i j k
    -- canonical pushforwards of the three trivializations to the triple overlap
    set ρi : S i →ₐ[A] W i j k := (face₁₂ f T W i j k).comp (inclLeft f S T i j) with hρi
    set ρj : S j →ₐ[A] W i j k := (face₁₂ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T i j) with hρj
    set ρk : S k →ₐ[A] W i j k := (face₂₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T j k) with hρk
    have key : Units.map (face₂₃ f T W i j k).toRingHom.toMonoidHom
          (trivializationCocycle f S T e j k)
        * Units.map (face₁₂ f T W i j k).toRingHom.toMonoidHom
            (trivializationCocycle f S T e i j)
        = Units.map (face₁₃ f T W i j k).toRingHom.toMonoidHom
            (trivializationCocycle f S T e i k) := by
      rw [trivializationCocycle, trivializationCocycle, trivializationCocycle,
        ← map_transitionUnit, ← map_transitionUnit, ← map_transitionUnit,
        trivializationPush_trivializationPush, trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
        trivializationPush_trivializationPush, trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
        trivializationPush_trivializationPush, trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
        show (face₂₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclLeft f S T j k) = ρj from
          (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers (f j))).elim _ _,
        show (face₂₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T j k) = ρk from rfl,
        show (face₁₂ f T W i j k).comp (inclLeft f S T i j) = ρi from rfl,
        show (face₁₂ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T i j) = ρj from rfl,
        show (face₁₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclLeft f S T i k) = ρi from
          (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers (f i))).elim _ _,
        show (face₁₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T i k) = ρk from
          (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers (f k))).elim _ _]
      exact transitionUnit_mul_transitionUnit _ _ _
    have hval := congrArg Units.val key
    simpa only [Units.val_mul, Units.coe_map, AlgHom.toRingHom_toMonoidHom_apply]
      using hval

/-! ## The Picard class of the transition cocycle -/

/-- **Descent identification for locally trivialized modules**: the Picard class of the
descent cocycle associated with the transition cocycle of a family of trivializations of
`N` is the class of `N`.  The assembled trivialization over the cover algebra
intertwines the twisted descent datum of the transition cocycle with the canonical datum
on `B ⊗[A] N` — componentwise this is the defining property of the transition units —
so uniqueness of descent identifies the descended module with `N`. -/
theorem picClass_trivializationCocycle [Module.Invertible A N]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat A (∀ i, S i)] :
    (isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit f S T W
        (isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle f S T W e)).picClass
      = CommRing.Pic.mk A N := by
  set B := ∀ i, S i with hB
  set u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ := cocycleUnit f S T (trivializationCocycle f S T e) with hu'
  set hu := isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit f S T W
    (isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle f S T W e)
  set ψ : (B ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[B] B := piTrivialization e with hψ
  -- the values of the assembled trivialization on `1 ⊗ₜ n` lie in the descended module
  have hkey : ∀ n : N,
      u.val * descentIncl₁ A B (ψ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) = descentIncl₂ A B (ψ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) := by
    intro n
    apply (piDoubleEquiv f S T).injective
    rw [map_mul, piDoubleEquiv_cocycleUnit_val, piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₁,
      piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₂]
    funext p
    rw [Pi.mul_apply]
    have hval : ψ (1 ⊗ₜ n) = fun i ↦ e i (1 ⊗ₜ n) := piTrivialization_one_tmul e n
    rw [hval]
    exact trivializationCocycle_mul f S T e p.1 p.2 n
  -- the assembled trivialization intertwines the two descent data
  have he : ∀ x : B ⊗[A] N,
      (DescentDatum.ofUnit u hu).coaction (ψ x)
        = ((ψ : B ⊗[A] N →ₗ[B] B).restrictScalars A).baseChange B
            ((DescentDatum.baseChange A B N).coaction x) := by
    intro x
    induction x with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul b n =>
        have hb : (b ⊗ₜ[A] n : B ⊗[A] N) = b • ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] n) := by
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
        set s : B := ψ (1 ⊗ₜ n) with hs
        have hψb : ψ (b ⊗ₜ n) = b * s := by
          rw [hb, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [hψb, ofUnit_coaction, unitCoaction_apply, DescentDatum.baseChange_coaction,
          LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
        have hmul : ((b * s) ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B) : B ⊗[A] B)
            = (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) * (s ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) := by
          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one]
        have hkey' : u.val * (s ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) = (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] s := hkey n
        calc u.val * (b * s) ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)
            = (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) * (u.val * (s ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B))) := by
              rw [hmul]; ring
          _ = (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) * ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] s) := by rw [hkey']
          _ = b ⊗ₜ[A] ψ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] n) := by
              rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, hs]
              rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  -- uniqueness of descent identifies the descended module with `N`
  have equivN : N ≃ₗ[A] hu.descended :=
    (DescentDatum.ofUnit u hu).equivDescended ψ he
  exact CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨equivN.symm⟩

end IsLocalization.AwayCover
